known_access_blockers.name: holdat-corpus-csv
known_access_blockers.needed_by: The legacy loaders inspected for this work package: backend/glossa_lab/pipelines/provenance_audit.py (its HOLDAT_CSV constant; Spec 006 step 3 token coverage and site_invariance) and backend/scripts/phase69_site_stratification.py. It is NOT an input of the frozen Spec 076 pilot runner: pilot_run.py reads only inputs/indus_research.jsonl, inputs/INDUS_FINAL_ANCHORS.json, and strict-coding-output.json. Its absence therefore does not block the Spec 076 replay, and does block those legacy-loader recomputations in this staged tree.
known_access_blockers.status_in_staged_tree: Absent. The corpora/ directory is not in the staged work tree, is not in the repository tree (a recursive tree listing shows no corpora/ path), and the GitHub contents API returns 404 for the documented path. It is a downloaded external corpus, not a committed file.
known_access_blockers.lawful_acquisition_route: Download the Holdat LLC Indus corpus from its external repository (the source of the corpora/downloads/external_repos/holdatllc_indus/ directory in a full local checkout, as documented in Spec 006 step 3 and in provenance_audit.py) and place the CSV at the documented local path. No hash for this file is stated in the frozen Spec 076 material, so none is recorded here; inventing one would be false.
